newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sabvest buys 20 pct of Learning Resources.
newsitem.headline: Sabvest buys 20 pct of Learning Resources.

text.p: South Africa's Sabvest Ltd said on Friday that it had acquired 20 percent of private firm Learning Resources Ltd.
Learning Resources is a firm formed to run the operations of Concord Training, Gallovision and MVT which distribute learning solution through video and computer-based products.
Sabvest said the buy, for an undisclosed sum, would have no immediate effect on its earnings or net asset value.
